classification.difficultyReason: Apply the supplied half-scale factor to each displacement from the centre, placing image vertices halfway towards the original vertices.

content.prompt: Scale the square below by a factor of $\frac{1}{2}$ using $O$ as the centre of enlargement.

spec.description: Eight-column, six-row writable grid with a marked centre and a four-by-four square. A blank-grid template cannot express the supplied square and centre.
spec.mathematics: O=(1,3); original square [3,7] by [1,5] in lower-left grid coordinates.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the original square and centre are visible.

answer.worked: Place each image vertex halfway from $O$ to the corresponding original vertex. The image vertices are 1 right and 1 down, 3 right and 1 down, 3 right and 1 up, and 1 right and 1 up from $O$. Join them to form a square of side 2 grid units.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 4; matched teacher PDF page 74, Section C question 4
